cells.contract: A proposed Sirius shell would expose one scoped command and its verified result.
blockers: A platform owner and an admitted integration contract are required.
cells.next_action: Agree with the shell owner on a single safe read command and the local authority boundary.
cells.expected_artifact: Versioned shell adapter contract and read-only smoke program.
acceptance_criteria: A shell-owned result matches an independent observation under an explicit grant.

cells.contract: A proposed ns-nova adapter would expose an application-owned operation with a typed result.
blockers: A platform owner and an admitted integration contract are required.
cells.next_action: Identify one application-owned action and document the data and authorization mapping.
cells.expected_artifact: Reviewed application contract and interoperability fixture.
acceptance_criteria: The fixture maps typed arguments and verifies the observed application result.

cells.contract: A proposed XR adapter would resolve a semantic scene object and verify its state after one action.
blockers: A platform owner and an admitted integration contract are required.
cells.next_action: Define scene identity, lifetime, observation and an explicit user-granted action.
cells.expected_artifact: Scoped XR object contract and acceptance scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Stale identities fail and an independent observation confirms a successful transition.

cells.contract: A proposed host would expose a bounded system resource operation under explicit ownership.
blockers: A platform owner and an admitted integration contract are required.
cells.next_action: Name the resource, its owner and the effect boundary before defining a platform adapter.
acceptance_criteria: The fixture verifies resource ownership before and after a denied, cancelled or accepted action.

cells.contract: A proposed system authority model would link a resource grant to an issuer, scope and revocation domain across process boundaries.
blockers: A platform owner and an admitted integration contract are required.
cells.next_action: Specify issuer and propagation rules for one revocable resource grant.
cells.expected_artifact: System resource authority specification and denial/revocation cases.
acceptance_criteria: A revoked cross-process grant cannot commit an action, with observable evidence at the resource owner.
